title: Comparing Methods to Biopsy Pancreas Mass
brief_summary: This study will examine whether there is any difference in number of passes needed to diagnose pancreatic masses during endoscopic ultrasound-guided biopsies using 2 different types of needles.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* adult
* pancreas mass

Exclusion Criteria:

* coagulopathy
* mass not approachable by endoscopic ultrasound biopsy
